query: Why are my discounted Singtel shares not reflected in my Central Depository (CDP) statement?
reference_answer: Your discounted Singtel shares are held by the Board on your behalf. Your discounted Singtel shares would therefore be reflected in your CPF Statement of Account.
answer: Your discounted Singtel shares might not be immediately reflected in your CDP statement due to delayed processing times for such transactions. This delay can occur even if the shares have been credited to your account. [Document 1]
